name: marquee
title: Marquee
description: An endless horizontal band that coasts to a stop when you point at it or tab into it and picks up speed when you leave, with a pause button (WCAG 2.2.2). The content is copied just often enough to leave no gap; the copies are hidden from screen readers and the Tab key, and keyboard focus glides the focused item into view.
author: ARLing s. r. o. (https://arling.sk)

.am-marquee-viewport.-webkit-mask-image: linear-gradient(to right, transparent, #000 var(--am-marquee-fade), #000 calc(100% - var(--am-marquee-fade)), transparent)
.am-marquee-viewport.mask-image: linear-gradient(to right, transparent, #000 var(--am-marquee-fade), #000 calc(100% - var(--am-marquee-fade)), transparent)

docs:
Marquee from ARLing Motion (MIT).
React: import { Marquee, MarqueeItem } from "@/components/ui/motion-marquee".
The logic is in lib/arling-motion-marquee.js (typed by the .d.ts next to it) and works without React: createMarquee on your own markup.
Styles were added to your global CSS under @layer components (Tailwind v4).
With Tailwind v3 or no Tailwind, add https://arling.sk/motion/components/marquee/marquee.css to your styles instead.
Live demo and docs: https://arling.sk/motion/#marquee
